title: Group the values of a query string
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Read one query string like `b=2&a=1&a=3`: pairs joined by `&`, each `key=value`; a pair with no `=` is a key with an empty value. Print the keys in alphabetical order, separated by spaces, each as `key=` followed by its values in the order they appeared, joined by commas: `a=1,3 b=2`.
